label: October 2026
title: October 2026 Season Recap: A Bruising Road Trip
body:
Erwann, think of October like an ugly mid-season road trip where we took some hard hits on the scoreboard.

**The Standings:**
We finished 8-28. Our account slid from $10,000 to $7,928.44 (-20.7%), while the S&P 500 merely dipped 1.7% to $9,833. We definitely lost ground in the division.

**Trade of the Month (Highlight Reel):**
Our short on Boeing (BA). Arjun's quant momentum squad nailed the breakdown, patiently riding it down into our $173 target for a clean +$217 profit (+2.23R). Textbook execution.

**The Worst Trade (Costly Fumble):**
Intel (INTC) earnings. We went long expecting an upside pop, but horrific forward guidance caused an unholy gap-down past our stop, exiting near $66 for a -$495 loss (-4.18R). Big lesson: never step in front of high-volatility earnings without strict gap protection.

**Comeback Story & Staffing Drama:**
Despite the slump, Ashley Brennan kept the locker room unified—zero pink slips handed out. Meanwhile, our interns (Sienna, Dev, and Zoe) quietly stayed in the green with ~$140 equity each, giving the veterans a run for their money.

**MVP:**
Elena Castillo took the crown, delivering a stellar 67% win rate across a massive 577 research decisions. Special nod to Nadia Volkov, who correctly called the bear tape 60% of the time.

**Next Month’s Gameplan:**
We're benching naked earnings gambles, letting Elena call the offensive plays, and rebuilding the bankroll with disciplined base hits.
mvp: Elena Castillo (Portfolio Manager & Head of Research) – 67% accuracy across 577 calls
